recentItems.title: Watch: Videos show aftermath of nor'easter as streets flooded, events cancelled
recentItems.description:

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: From red and blue to black and silver: Why America's cars have lost their color
recentItems.description:
If you take a look around on the road these days, you may notice cars seem a lot less colorful. Bright blues, reds, and yellows have increasingly given way to black, white, and silver. CBS News' Evyn Moon looks at why America's cars have lost their color.

recentItems.title: Saturday Sessions: Karina Rykman performs "Shoegaze Summer"
recentItems.description:
New York City native Karina Rykman has earned accolades for her unmissable live act. The singer-songwriter and bassist recently celebrated the release of her new studio album, "Late Checkout," at Zabar's, becoming the first band to play at the iconic Upper West Side delicatessen. Here's Karina Rykman with "Shoegaze Summer."

recentItems.title: Smithsonian's National Museum of African American History celebrates 10th anniversary
recentItems.description:
The Smithsonian's National Museum of African American History and Culture is marking a major milestone this week - celebrating its 10-year anniversary. Photojournalist Parrish Smith looks back at when the doors opened, takes us inside to see some current exhibitions, and makes a stop at the museum's Sweet Home Cafe.
